simple.meaning: מִפְרָשׂ (miphrâs) is a Hebrew action word meaning “an expansion.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Job, Ezekiel, beginning at Job 36:29. The surrounding contexts include Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִפְרָשׂ (H4666) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מִפְרָשׂ (miphrâs) / H4666 is traced through Job 36:29, Ezekiel 27:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H4666. miphras [ מִפְרָשׂ ] noun [masculine] spreading out, things spread ; — suffix מִפְרָשֵׂךְ Ezek 27:7 thy spread (canvas, as sail, compare verb Isa 33:23 ); plural construct עָב מִפְרְשֵׂי Job 36:29 , so perhaps 37:16 ( for מִפְלְשֵׂי ).
